baseline.qualification: Sampled non-atomic st_blocks accounting, including directories; no hard filesystem quota or inter-sample growth guarantee. At most three fresh complete scans share one time budget; only singly linked regular files occur in an accepted scan. Transient links may occur between/during discarded observations.

projected_parquet_temporary_file.allocation: O_TMPFILE or unlink-before-return; projected writes begin only after return
projected_parquet_temporary_file.watch: unnamed extents excluded from sources pathname scan; physical Root floor still covers them

qualification: Sampled existing shared-source-parent accounting, with no concurrent mutation of other source stores. Includes all named new source files and historical baseline; unnamed temporary extents and external SQLite scratch are covered by the whole-volume free-disk floor and cumulative sampled minimum, not this tree scan. Density projection is an estimate, not a capacity bound or hard filesystem quota; retain any breached run permanently. No source body was read.

scope_reservations.qualification: Density estimates, not hard bounds. Named rollback reserve retained. Projected Parquet is materialized on Root as an unnamed file, not treated as read-only Data capacity. SQLite external/unnamed scratch remains covered by original whole-volume reservation/floor; no source ceiling increased.

scratch_scope.explicit_projected_parquet: new source scratch directory; TemporaryFile may be unnamed
